{{Quote|The twenty credits you lay out today can save you a lot of moss-gathering stones in a hard place.|Urrtie|<ref name="Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>}}
'''Urrtie''' was the uncle of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Cohden K'Reye]]. He was known for his idioms, and would impart advice regarding saving [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. K'Reye did not consider him the smartest of individuals, referring to Urrtie as "not the sharpest [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] in the armory", although would use his uncle's advice as the basis for his own wisdom imparted to fellow adventurers.
